entities.summary: Dennis R. Bell is an American former professional basketball player. Born in Cincinnati, Ohio, he played collegiately for Drake University. He was selected by the New York Knicks in the 5th round of the 1973 NBA draft. He played for the Knicks (1973–76) in the NBA for 63 games.
